## No extra room for a home office in Pune? Here's how people are creating space by storing furniture instead of giving up on the idea.


**[Self storage in Pune](https://stownest.com/self-storage-pune?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=self-storage-pune)** gives people the opportunity to clear a room to create a home office, by moving the furnishings to storage that is taking up the space, like an old bed, a bookshelf, and boxes that haven’t been touched in years. The furnishings no longer have to take up space in a home, and a home office can finally be in a convenient location.


## **The Room That Was Never Meant to Be a Home Office**


It's becoming common for home offices to spring up from storage. As more people work from home, storage spaces turn into makeshift offices. An old bedroom gets re-purposed to store old suits and ties, boxes of photographs, and souvenirs from vacations, and becomes a storage space. Over time, that storage space gets converted into a bedroom to accommodate another member of the family. Then one day, that same bedroom gets transformed into an office.


Clearly, working from home is here to stay. Working from dining room tables is not a good long term solution. Rearranging bedrooms to include a makeshift desk is not ideal, either.


## **When There's No Spare Room at All**


For the average person in Pune, it’s not about clearing out a spare room. Many don’t have spare rooms to begin with. Many Pune households consist of only 1 or 2 rooms, and those are already functioning as bedrooms and as living space. Working from home has become common and long term, and many have accepted that they will have to give up part of a bedroom in order to have a proper workspace.


This is very different from just requiring a more organized workspace. Here, a workspace must be created in a space that has no workspace. Furniture will have to be moved in order to create a workspace.


## **Why Compromising Has Become Normal**


A few years ago, setting up shop at the dining room table was an occasional event, and working from the bedroom was an emergency back up plan. Now, many people have transitioned to work from home situations and have converted spare rooms into home offices. If they don't have a spare room, they have converted their dining rooms or bedrooms into office space. In the process, they have eliminated or hidden furnishings that they previously used and enjoyed.


## **How Storage Allows You to Postpone the Decision**


With the help of self storage, a lot of different solutions to a lot of different storage problems become available. Here we are concerned with creating space for a home office. One way to do this is to use self storage to temporarily remove items that are occupying the space you would like to use for your home office. For example, a wardrobe, a bed, or a table that you do not actually need. When you use self storage in this way you can create a home office without giving anything up.


A great benefit of a **[pick up and delivery storage service](https://stownest.com/self-storage-pune?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=self-storage-pune)** is that the storage service does the transport for you. This means that the storage service would come and get the items you want stored for you. You can always change your mind and decide that you actually want that item back. This service would be the one to deliver the item back to you.


## **Why This Is More Relevant As Working From Home Is The New Normal**


Working from home is quickly becoming the standard in Pune, with IT and related service professionals working from both home and office. As a result, many people are setting up dedicated work from home facilities. While many assume that this would mean moving to bigger homes, that is not the case. The biggest issue is layout, not space. A good home office design can help improve your work from home quality and help you feel more productive and less stressed.


## **Why Moving to a Larger Place Isn’t the Solution**


When people realize their current living situation isn’t ideal because they don’t have a spare room, many people think the solution is to move to a larger place. However, you are actually paying more money to solve the same problem you had before. The issue before was that a regular room was used as a bedroom, and that room could also be used to store furniture, which could also be put in storage.


## **Who This Actually Helps**


This is probably the most helpful for people living in flats with all-purpose rooms, who have taken up home office work because of the pandemic. It is also helpful for people who have a permanent work-from-home situation, and for anyone who has been putting off setting up a home office due to the mental block of having to empty and clear a whole room first.


## **Your Home Office Is Probably Already There**


A Pune flat usually already has a room appropriate to use as a home office. It's just used for some other purpose at the moment. Self storage helps by getting rid of the current use of the room, and lets you make permanent decisions about the stuff you don't want to get rid of. This way the room can be converted to a home office.


## **Key Takeaways**


-


A lot of potential home office space in Pune is currently occupied by furniture that's neither in daily use nor easy to get rid of.


-


Deciding what to throw away often becomes the reason a home office never actually gets set up.


-


Self storage clears the room without requiring any permanent decisions about what to keep.


-


Pickup-and-delivery storage means furniture can be moved out, and brought back later if needed.


-


This is often a cheaper fix than renting a bigger home just to gain one extra functional room.

**1. Is using self storage to create a home office a good idea?**


Absolutely! If you want to create a home office, but don’t have the space, you can always use storage to free up space. Storage can help you clear the room quickly, so you can set up your office as soon as the furniture is out of the way.


**2. Can I get things back if I change my mind?**


You certainly can! You are always allowed to request an item for removal.


**3. Is storage cheaper than moving to a larger home?**


Storage is definitely less expensive than giving up a whole extra room.
